notes: An optional wide layout puts the input and output audio on the left and model controls on the right.
Open gary settings with the gear button to switch between wide and compact mode; the layout you pick is remembered.
The gear button replaces the storage button, and moving the gary4juce audio folder now lives in that same settings menu.
All three downloads contain universal x86_64/arm64 binaries and license information.
Close your DAW and the standalone app before replacing files with a downloaded update.
